caption: The drawing depicts a single, shallow, round bowl with a wide mouth and a slightly flared rim. The bowl is rendered in various shades of blue-green, giving it a transparent glass-like appearance. The form is defined with soft lines and shading to suggest light reflection and the curvature of the object. The bowl is centered on a plain, off-white background with no additional objects or decorative elements present. A small inscription with the name "Beverly Chichester" appears to the right of the bowl, indicating the artist’s signature.
title: Ribbed Glass Bowl
